description: This file defines `GroupOwnerSocketHandler`, a thread class responsible for handling incoming socket connections in a Wi-Fi Direct group owner setup. It sets up a server socket on port 4545 and uses a thread pool to manage client connection handling via `ChatManager` instances.

classes.name: GroupOwnerSocketHandler
classes.description: A thread class that manages incoming socket connections for a Wi-Fi Direct group owner, accepting connections and delegating each to a ChatManager running in a thread pool.

methods.name: GroupOwnerSocketHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the server socket on port 4545 and sets up the handler.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Continuously accepts incoming socket connections and executes a ChatManager for each connection; handles socket closure and pool shutdown on error.
